 Guardians News: Quiet Before the World Series Storm
 News and Notes for Thursday, October 22nd, 2026
 by Deborah Williams Oct 22, 2026, 3:08 PM UTC Facebook

 WILLIAMSPORT, PA - AUGUST 23: Milwaukee Brewers mascot Bernie Brewer looks on during the 2026 Little League Classic presented by New York Life between the Atlanta Braves and the Milwaukee Brewers at Journey Bank Ballpark at Historic Bowman Field on Sunday, August 23, 2026 in Williamsport, Pennsylvania. (Photo by Hailey Leonard/MLB Photos via Getty Images) MLB Photos via Getty Images The World Series starts tomorrow in Milwaukee at 8PM. First World Series against two teams who have never won a title since the 1980 title match.
 Tim Stebbins wrote about offseason questions for the Guardians.
 Zack Meisel wrote about the hitting and pitching issues that led to the Guardians losing three games straight in the ALCS. Of most note, Tanner Bibee said he is ready to make any changes needed to improve from his 2025-2026 performances.
 The Angels fired manager Kurt Suzuki after one disastrous season .
